decisions.managed: InferGenericCallArgument uses only fixed formals or types inferred from earlier arguments as context, before unification. Completed-call revalidation preserves compatibility checks but suppresses new numeric redundancy warnings. Both direct and flow additional roles share the helper.
decisions.slg: resolveSemanticCallArguments already calculates priorSpecialization before inserting the current argument, but excludes direct generic calls from contextualization. It later publishes final expected types and emits warnings from those without independent-context provenance. resolveCallResultTypes also gates prior argument contextualization on flow node kind10.
decisions.repair: Use the known prefix context for ordinary arguments too; preserve contextualInput provenance when producing suppressNumericWarning. Remove the flow-only gate in the earlier return inference pass for later arguments. Keep primary flow argument policy and final compatibility validation.

decisions.slg: bindFunctionSpecialization iterates every kind32 generic symbol and specializes each, then explicitly rejects arguments.len>3. typeRegistration.collect converts the binding error into unresolvedCalls and capturePreparedFunctionEmissions rejects those.
